measurement_notes: Five paired trials alternate implementation order; every worker starts a new process and copied index.
Model warmup, library copying and imports are outside per-request timings; operating-system caches are not cleared.
Native uses the actual application search engine including its configured knowledge branch; older bare-engine timings are a different boundary.
HTTP uses the actual FastAPI route and middleware through ASGITransport, including canonical evidence reads and serialization, excluding network and browser rendering.
Cold native first-use samples also include lazy jieba initialization, not only matrix construction.
Branch timings overlap and must not be added together.
Memory is the benchmark-hosted main application process, including benchmark bookkeeping, excluding the independent encoder child. Ending RSS is not peak RSS.
Synthetic scale and entity fixtures validate mechanics and output equality, not real-world semantic quality.
